finance.navigation.ledger.label: Ledger
finance.navigation.periods.label: Periods
finance.navigation.accounts.label: Ledger accounts
finance.navigation.tax-codes.label: Tax codes
finance.screens.tax-codes.help: The VAT rates prices, invoices and bills can carry. They are used only once the theatre is registered for VAT in Finance's settings. A code's rate cannot change once the ledger uses it: add a new code for a new rate, and stop using the old one.
finance.screens.tax-codes.code-help: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens. It never changes.
finance.screens.tax-codes.label: Name
finance.screens.tax-codes.rate-help: 20 for the standard rate, 5 for the reduced rate, 0 for zero-rated, exempt or outside the scope.
finance.screens.tax-codes.rate-fixed: The ledger already uses this code, so its rate is fixed.
finance.screens.tax-codes.in-scope-help: Off only for sales that are outside the scope of VAT altogether.
finance.screens.tax-codes.active-help: A code that is not offered stays on everything that already uses it.
finance.screens.ledger.empty-help: Every sale, refund, fee and payout is posted here as it happens. If you filtered or searched, try clearing it.
finance.screens.ledger.reverse-consequen: A posting with every entry the other way round is added today. The original stays in the ledger.
finance.screens.accounts.help: Rename and recode accounts to match your accounting package. Each account belongs to one module, which alone posts to it.
finance.screens.accounts.name: Name
finance.screens.accounts.module-help: Only this module can post to the account.
finance.screens.accounts.in-use-help: A retired account keeps its postings but takes no new ones.
finance.screens.accounts.locked: A module declared this account, so it cannot be retired.
finance.screens.periods.help: The ledger is kept a month at a time. Close a month once you have checked it, so nothing more can be posted into it.
finance.screens.periods.empty-help: A period is made when the first posting falls in it.
finance.screens.period.posted-help: Every posting in the period added up, both sides of the ledger agreeing.
finance.screens.period.held-help: Money taken in this period that becomes income later, such as tickets for performances still to come, or that is owed back.
finance.screens.period.running: This period can be closed from {day}
finance.screens.period.running-help: It is still running, so there is nothing to do here yet. What would stop it closing is listed once it has ended.
finance.screens.period.movement-help: Each income and expense account that moved in this period.
finance.screens.period.movement-summary: Income of {income} and expenses of {expense} in this period. Each account's figure is in the list below.
finance.screens.period.checklist-help: Each of these stops the period closing. Most link to where they are put right.
finance.screens.period.warnings: Worth knowing before you close it. None of this stops the close:
finance.screens.period.close-consequence: Nothing more can be posted into it. Anything dated inside it from now on goes into the next open period.
finance.screens.period.reopen-help: Reopening lets postings into the period again until it is closed again. The reason is kept with it.
finance.navigation.productions.label: Production statements
finance.navigation.reconcile.label: Reconciliation
finance.screens.productions.empty: No production has money in the ledger yet
finance.screens.productions.empty-help: A production appears here once tickets or anything else for it are paid for.
finance.screens.statement.title: {production}: statement
finance.screens.statement.empty: Nothing posted for this production yet
finance.screens.statement.empty-help: Sales, refunds and anything else tagged with the production appear here once paid.
finance.screens.statement.held: Held for performances still to come
finance.screens.statement.how: Every amount posted with this production, by account. Income reads positive and refunds negative. Payment provider fees are charged per payment rather than per production, so they appear only where a module recorded them against the production.
finance.screens.reconcile.help: Card money sits with the provider until it pays out to the bank. Each line is what a provider should still be holding for you. Compare it with the balance the provider shows; a difference means a payout or a payment has not been entered.
finance.screens.reconcile.last-payout: Last payout {day}; {total} paid out in all
finance.screens.reconcile.payouts-help: What reached the bank, newest first. A payout missing here has not been entered yet.
finance.screens.reconcile.empty-help: Each card provider account appears here once it has taken its first payment.
finance.screens.export.title: Export the ledger
finance.screens.export.help: A CSV of every posting in a range of days, one row per entry with account codes, for your accounting package.
finance.screens.export.period-help: Choosing one fills in its first and last day.
finance.screens.tax-code-select.label: Tax code
finance.screens.tax-code-select.help: Prices include the VAT at this code.
